description: An empty suit of medieval plate armor moving under magical force, with no visible wearer inside. Articulated breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, greaves, and boots moving as a complete hollow suit. Broad simple metal plates with a few dents and edge lines, avoiding ornate engraving. Full humanoid armor silhouette in a deliberate stepping pose, rigid plates separated by dark empty gaps.
